NAME
    cssh - Open ClusterSSH

SYNOPSIS

    confctl [global options] cssh [command options] [machine-pattern]

COMMAND OPTIONS
    -a, --attr=arg - Filter by attribute (may be used more than once, default:
                     none)
    --managed=arg  - Filter (un)managed machines (default: none)
    -t, --tag=arg  - Filter by tag (may be used more than once, default: none)
    -y, --[no-]yes - Assume the answer to confirmations is yes
